major.zero: Foundational assembly and construction; first complete buildable Leo application has not yet been declared

minor.increment_when: Each delivered feature addition or functional, configuration, or app-resource change

patch.increment_when: Analyzer, static-test, small bug, stability, or compatibility correction without feature addition or material behavior change

channel_meanings.RELEASE: Final icon/branding, production signing, packaging and publication

rules: Channel is stored separately and is not a fourth numeric version component.
Never reuse a version for different application contents.
Feature/functional/resource change increments MINOR and resets PATCH to zero.
Major generation change increments MAJOR and resets MINOR and PATCH to zero.
Documentation-only edits do not change the application version unless app content, configuration, assets or packaging changes.
Signing an unchanged binary does not itself require a public version bump.
Replacing the actual application icon is an app-resource change and increments MINOR unless the exact asset was already part of the tested candidate.

Flutter pubspec uses MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH+BUILD; BUILD is separate platform build metadata, not a fourth public version component. Increment it only when producing a new installable binary that requires a monotonically increasing platform build number.
